subject.title: [codex] Honor all ack scope for room events

question: Should `messages.ackReactionScope: "all"` intentionally acknowledge ambient `room_event` messages across Discord, Slack, and Telegram once typing and lifecycle status reactions remain suppressed?
rationale: The code fix is straightforward, but accepting it changes visible behavior for existing quiet-room configurations that previously remained reaction-silent.

options.title: Accept ack-only room events
options.body: Proceed with the shared `all` semantics after the Slack typing fix and live proof show only the configured plain ack appears.

options.title: Preserve silent room events
options.body: Reject the runtime behavior change and instead clarify docs/schema that ambient room events are excluded from auto acks.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Ask for a separate opt-in surface, accepting the extra config burden and migration proof that would come with it.

recommendation.title: Accept ack-only room events
recommendation.body: Proceed with the shared `all` semantics after the Slack typing fix and live proof show only the configured plain ack appears.
